name: web/hinged-panel
title: Hinged panel
summary: One offline HTML demonstration of a rectangular panel swinging about a specified edge on a stationary frame.
when: Use for a single illustrative hatch, flap, or door and a top, bottom, left, or right edge hinge. The panel opens on a labeled control and starts closed. Choose it when the blanks cover the requested design and behavior.

filename.about: Output file name ending in .html or .htm, without a folder

edge.about: Single fixed hinge edge: top, bottom, left, or right

part.about: Plain name of the moving part

detail.about: Plain text revealed when the panel opens
detail.default: The opening behind the panel is exposed.

angle.about: Opening angle in whole degrees from 35 through 80

direction.about: Free edge swings toward or away from the viewer

button_label.about: Stable accessible name of the toggle button

scene_id.about: HTML ID of the scene (a letter followed by letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores)

frame_id.about: HTML ID of the fixed frame

leaf_id.about: HTML ID of the moving leaf

toggle_id.about: HTML ID of the native control button

status_id.about: HTML ID of the visible status

detail_id.about: HTML ID of the revealed detail element

next: Use look_at_page if requested to check the saved page. The button moves the panel between its two poses.
change: For a later edit, read the saved file and make a scoped edit in place. The original component creates new files only.
